Free Photo Video — Turn Photos Into Shareable Videos, initial release:

- Convert photos (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC, up to 200MB) into 1080p MP4 slideshow videos in 30–60 seconds using cloud GPUs.
- Simple workflow: upload images, describe your desired video (music, transitions, etc.), and receive a downloadable MP4.
- Automatic backend connection and free token handling on first use (100 free credits, 7-day token).
- Includes quick actions for exporting, checking credits, uploading, and showing video status.
- Supports batch and iterative editing; all rendering occurs server-side with no local install required.
- Built-in error handling and concise user communication throughout the editing and export process.
